assets.scope: Standee batch 1 (17 ids). Second artwork used only for the upright standee layer at <=48px cells. Identity evidence: the shipped native sprite and the shipped flat token, both pinned below; the game was not launched for this round. Flat 128px token, its master and the manifest mapping are untouched.
assets.gate_reason: The shipped flat 128px cut-out is a near-square top-down token; at the 1.0-cell standee width cap it is width-bound and renders about one cell tall, reading as the flat token rather than an upright standee. A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.
assets.desc: One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.

references.note: The shipped flat champion-of-urh-rok token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.

Native champion-of-urh-rok sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
The shipped faeros token shares this fire-demon palette and body plan, so it is the token this one must stay clearly distinct from; do not copy its pose or its flame shape.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: champion of Urh'Rok: a massive demonic humanoid in blackened plate armour with a horned helm, spiked heavy pauldrons, a dark crimson underlayer and eyes burning red, gripping a huge two-handed sword. Match the shipped token's black-red armour and the native sprite's horns and red glow.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height with the sword raised or held vertical close to the body, shoulders broad but with the horns the only part above the head. Do not add an aura, flames or particles.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, upright standing front three-quarter view, both hands on the sword hilt, feet planted, the horned helm at the top of the frame. Overall height to width about 1.7 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: blackened steel plate with dark red trim and bronze rivets, dark crimson flesh, burning red eyes, bone-white horn tips.

prompt_fields.subject: forge-giant: a massive living forge demon of cracked black iron and white-hot molten metal, its head a horned iron mask wreathed in a mane of orange flame, gripping a heavy underworld forge hammer in each hand. Match the shipped token's black-iron and orange fire and the native sprite's two hammers.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: stand at full height with both hammers held low at hip level and the arms not fully spread. The fire mane rises above the head but must not widen the figure; no lightning, no scattered particles, no ground fire.

prompt_fields.palette: blackened iron plates with glowing orange cracks, molten yellow-white hot metal, deep orange flame, no background.
